newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ASJ Holdings Singapore offer 150 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: ASJ Holdings Singapore offer 150 times subscribed.

text.p: Electronics firm ASJ Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday the public tranche of 9.75 million shares in its initial public offer (IPO) was 150 times subscribed.

The company had offered a total of 15 million new shares at Singapore $0.52 each in its IPO, of which 3.75 million shares were placed and 1.5 million taken up by company management, employees and associates.

Trading on a when-issued basis is expected to begin on January 31 on Singapore's secondary board, SESDAQ. ASJ has said it hoped to raise S$7.2 million from the IPO to allow it to expand. -- Singapore Newsroom 65-8703080
